nameChecks.en: Don't Take It Away From Me...

gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto X part 2 records. Body and part HP parentheses and unconfirmed Stagger positions remain explicitly uncertain. Tangling reduction requires defense use, while Give It Back checks equipped defense. Cleansing win/loss perspectives, per-skill pool reduction, forced turn ends, negative Coins, and Panic conversion are retained.

name.text: Blackthread of the Elden Sea (Canto X, Route B)

lead.text: Reduce Tangling through defense and Cleansing to prevent Abyssal Maw's reuse. Staggering a part ends the turn, after which the enemy hides in a Pool of Black Water. Remove the pools with multiple Attack Skills, then prepare for predation and attacks concentrated on Pwie.

listLead.text: Reduce Tangling through defense and Cleansing to prevent Abyssal Maw reuse. Part Stagger ends the turn and brings Pool of Black Water next turn. Clear pools with multiple Attack Skills, then prepare for predation and attacks on the Assist Unit.

statNote.text: Covers the Route B, 5F encounter in Canto X. Lv. 65, base Defense Level 67, Speed 1–2. Listed HP is body 6,022 (6,691), each arm 1,989 (2,209), and torso 2,650 (2,944); whether the parenthesized values represent starting or maximum HP is unconfirmed. Stagger percentages and some threshold positions are also unconfirmed; do not reverse-calculate percentages. Yi Sang, Meursault, and Gregor are required; up to 12 Sinners can deploy. Identity levels in this dungeon follow Customer Level, and Identities below Uptie III are raised to III; E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged.

skillNote.text: All Coins are negative. During Panic, every Coin becomes Unbreakable, so winning a clash cannot fully prevent hits. Cleansing is a Counter used by each part. Clumped Black Threads increases Clash Power on arm skills, but lowers it on the torso's Thrashing of an Elden Being and Tangling.

priorities.0.text: Intercept attacks on Pwie at the opening and during Panic. Watch for extra Power if Pwie remains the main target.

priorities.1.text: Reduce Tangling by using defense or Cleansing. Do not let Staggered Sinners or those with 20 or more Tangling receive Abyssal Maw.

priorities.2.text: Remove the post-Stagger Pool of Black Water with the number of Attack Skills, not Coin count.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: A lethal follow-up occurred despite winning the clash

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: On Hit, Abyssal Maw reuses its Coin if the target is Staggered or has at least 20 Tangling, dealing fixed damage equal to 150% max HP. During Panic, Unbreakable Coins remain after a clash win; choose a healthy recipient with little Tangling.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Attacks focus on Pwie and the enemy's Power is high

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: The enemy starts Panicked and targets Pwie with every attack during Panic. Leaving Pwie as the main target increases Base and Clash Power. Intercept with Sinners, using clashes available regardless of Speed too.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: Tangling did not immediately decrease after selecting defense

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Tangling decreases when a Defense Skill is used, removing half the current Stack, rounded down. Merely equipping defense does not instantly remove it. Ensure an opportunity to use defense, and use a clash with Cleansing to remove it all.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: Stagger ended the turn and my attacks stopped dealing damage

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: Staggering a part forcibly ends the turn, and all parts gain Pool of Black Water next turn. Its 100% damage reduction changes the usual approach of focusing damage during Stagger. Hit each part with Attack Skills to reduce pool Potency.

troubleshooting.4.symptom.text: A multi-hit attack barely reduced the pool

troubleshooting.4.advice.text: The pool loses Potency only once per skill when hit. Use multiple skills rather than one with many Coins. It also expires over time, but that grants Instinct of the Predator of Eld next turn; prepare for the buff.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare Pierce damage and defense to reduce Tangling

phases.0.steps.0.text: Finish shopping toward Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank. Yi Sang, Meursault, and Gregor are required. Prepare opportunities to use defense and HP recovery; do not rely on only one Sinner to receive Abyssal Maw.

phases.0.steps.1.text: All enemy attacks are Blunt. Check Blunt resistance; offensively, use Pierce 1.2 and Wrath, Lust, Gluttony, and Pride 1.2. Slash and Blunt are 0.8; Gloom and Envy are 0.75.

phases.0.steps.2.text: He Who Nails lets Meursault gain 2 extra E.G.O resources matching a used skill's affinity, twice per turn. Its survival effect requires another ally alive at Turn Start, so protect the other Sinners too.

phases.1.title.text: Intercept attacks on Pwie with Sinners

phases.1.steps.0.text: The enemy starts Panicked. In that state, all targets are Pwie and all Coins become Unbreakable. Check each slot's target and clash with Sinners.

phases.1.steps.1.text: If Pwie is the main target during Panic, Clash Power +6 and Base Power +4. Low Morale also grants +3 and +2. Distinguish the prediction while Pwie is targeted from the values after redirecting to a Sinner.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Many skills are clashable regardless of Speed. Assign recipients with few statuses to Abyssal Maw and attacks that forcibly Stagger targets with at least 15 Tangling.

phases.1.steps.3.text: Panic resets SP to 0 at Turn End, but clash losses can lower it again. Do not assume low SP means safety; check current Unbreakable Coins and targets every turn.

phases.2.timing.text: Each turn and when Tangling rises

phases.2.title.text: Reduce Tangling and rotate dangerous clashes

phases.2.steps.0.text: Tangling increases damage taken, lowers Base Power by 1 per 10 Stack, and applies Bind next turn per 3 Stack at Turn End. Do not keep assigning strong clashes to a heavily affected Sinner.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Using a Defense Skill removes half the current Tangling, rounded down. The left arm's Give It Back... deals 90% less damage if the recipient has defense equipped, making it a useful opportunity to defend.

phases.2.steps.2.text: When Cleansing appears, take a winnable clash with a Sinner carrying Tangling. Their Tangling is fully removed regardless of the result. If you win, half that part's Blackstitch remains, rounded up.

phases.2.steps.3.text: Abyssal Maw reuses its Coin On Hit against Staggered targets or those with at least 20 Tangling; the reused hit deals fixed damage equal to 150% max HP. Do not rely solely on the post-clash removal of 10 Tangling; rotate to a less affected Sinner.

phases.3.title.text: Focus one part and build Blackstitch

phases.3.steps.0.text: Focus damage on the part you want to Stagger rather than spreading attacks across parts. Arms can still be attacked after destruction. Some Stagger positions are unconfirmed; check the actual gauge too.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Each hit gives the enemy 1 Bursting Blackstitch, plus 1 more for Slash. It increases damage taken by Stack%, and grants 1 Fragile per 25 Stack at Turn Start. Slash is resisted at 0.8, so weigh Blackstitch buildup against direct damage.

phases.3.steps.2.text: A hit from a skill with at least 5 Atk Weight grants Clumped Black Threads next turn, once per turn. It increases damage taken but also raises part slot weight. Area attacks may not reach every part; check the target display.

phases.3.steps.3.text: Clumped Black Threads raises arm Clash Power but lowers it on the torso's Thrashing of an Elden Being and Tangling. Check each part's modifier, and finish necessary healing before triggering Stagger.

phases.4.timing.text: Part Stagger and the next turn

phases.4.title.text: Clear pools with multiple Attack Skills

phases.4.steps.0.text: When any part is Staggered, each other part loses one Stagger Threshold and the turn ends immediately. Do not plan on all remaining attacks or healing resolving.

phases.4.steps.1.text: All parts gain Pool of Black Water next turn. They take 100% less damage, cannot be Staggered, and deal 100% more unopposed damage. Keep clashing instead of ignoring attacks, and use spare skills to reduce pool Potency.

phases.4.steps.2.text: The pool loses 1 Potency when hit, once per skill. Check each part's remaining value and hit it with multiple Attack Skills. It also loses 1 Count at Turn End and expires when either Potency or Count reaches 0.

phases.4.steps.3.text: A part whose pool is removed by hits gains 10 Blackstitch. If the gain exceeds the Blackstitch cap, it also gains 3 Fragile this turn and next turn. If the pool expires over time, it gains Instinct of the Predator of Eld next turn; check how it was removed.

phases.5.title.text: Prepare for repeated Maws and damage the weakened parts

phases.5.steps.0.text: Prepare for the predation pattern after pools expire. The torso uses four Abyssal Maws; divide clashes among multiple Sinners and avoid assigning Staggered recipients or those with at least 20 Tangling.

phases.5.steps.1.text: Each part with Instinct of the Predator of Eld grants +2 Clash Power to all parts. Damage also increases with the recipient's Tangling. After pools expire over time, prioritize strong clashes and Tangling control.

phases.5.steps.2.text: Parts with more Blackstitch take more damage. Focus strong attacks after the pools disappear; when the Cleansing Counter appears, also use it to remove Tangling.

phases.5.steps.3.text: Damage and Stagger Threshold rise from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are reduced by 50%. Do not rely on statuses alone; finish with direct skill damage too.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Maximum 30. Take +1% damage per Stack and lose 1 Base Power per 10 Stack. At Turn End, gain 1 Bind next turn per 3 Stack, up to 10. Using defense removes half the current Stack, with the amount removed rounded down.

mechanics.0.response.text: Reduce it with defense and Cleansing to avoid forced Stagger and Abyssal Maw's reuse condition.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Maximum 6 Potency and 2 Count. On Hit, lose 1 Potency, once per skill; at Turn End, lose 1 Count. Expires when either reaches 0. Cannot be Staggered, takes 100% less damage, and deals 100% more unopposed damage.

mechanics.1.response.text: Reduce Potency with multiple Attack Skills rather than Coin count. Keep clashing too.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Maximum 50. Damage taken +1% per Stack; gain 1 Fragile per 25 Stack at Turn Start. Increases from hits and pool removal. At 25 or more, the arms may replace Gloom skills with Cleansing; the torso uses Cleansing at 50 on certain actions.

mechanics.2.response.text: Focus damage on parts with high Stack. Clashing with Cleansing also removes Sinners' Tangling.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Maximum 5. Increases each part's slot weight by Stack and damage taken by 10% per Stack. Raises Clash Power on several arm skills by Stack, but lowers it on the torso's Thrashing of an Elden Being and Tangling.

mechanics.3.response.text: Gained from attacks with at least 5 Atk Weight. Weigh the damage benefit against area targeting coverage and increased arm Clash Power.

mechanics.4.name.text: Instinct of the Predator of Eld

mechanics.4.effect.text: Each part with this effect grants all parts +2 Clash Power. Damage +5% per 3 Tangling on the recipient, up to 50%. Expires at Turn End. Gained next turn when a pool expires at Turn End.

mechanics.4.response.text: After pools expire over time, handle predation with strong clashes and Sinners carrying little Tangling.

mechanics.5.effect.text: At −20 SP or lower, skills against Pwie gain +3 Clash Power and +2 Base Power; inflict 1 Tangling when hit, up to 3 times per skill. At −45 or lower, target Pwie with everything, make all Coins Unbreakable, increase those bonuses to +6 and +4, and inflict Tangling up to 6 times per skill.

mechanics.5.response.text: Starts Panicked and targets Pwie. Intercept with Sinners; do not treat low SP as a simple debuff.

mechanics.6.effect.text: Meursault gains two extra resources of his skill's affinity on use, twice per turn. With another ally alive at Turn Start, cannot die from damage that turn. Cannot retreat.

mechanics.6.response.text: Use him for resources and receiving attacks while keeping other Sinners alive.

mechanics.7.effect.text: Raised through department-store shopping with eyeballs; determines dungeon Identity levels.

mechanics.7.response.text: Prepare for Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank.

warnings.0.text: During Panic, all attacks target Pwie and all Coins are Unbreakable. Expect attacks to remain after a clash win.

warnings.1.text: Abyssal Maw reuses On Hit against a Staggered target or one with at least 20 Tangling, dealing fixed damage equal to 150% max HP. Check the recipient's condition first.

warnings.2.text: Tangling decreases when defense is used, not immediately on equipping it.

warnings.3.text: Part Stagger immediately ends the turn. Handle next turn's pools differently from a normal Stagger damage opening.

warnings.4.text: Pool Potency decreases once per skill. Letting it expire over time grants the predator buff next turn.

warnings.5.text: The meanings of parenthesized body and part HP, Stagger percentages, and some threshold positions remain unconfirmed. Check the gauge; do not build a fixed sequence from reverse-calculated numbers.

preparation.0.text: Aim for Customer Lv. 65 and Diamond rank. Check defense and HP recovery on the required Yi Sang, Meursault, and Gregor too.

preparation.1.text: Build mainly around Pierce with Wrath, Lust, Gluttony, and Pride attacks. Status effects are halved, so value direct skill damage too.

preparation.2.text: Prepare Blunt resistance and multiple clash recipients who can rotate to Sinners with less Tangling. Avoid Maw's reuse condition as well as winning its clash.

roles.0.reason.text: Intercept attacks on Pwie and handle four predation Maws while resting Sinners with high Tangling.

roles.1.name.text: Focused Pierce damage and repeated skills on parts

roles.1.reason.text: Build Blackstitch to damage parts; use multiple Attack Skills to remove pools.

roles.2.reason.text: Reduce Tangling and heal remaining Unbreakable damage. Finish necessary healing before triggering Stagger.

passives.0.effect.text:
At Stage Start, begin Panicked.

During Panic:
- Set all attack targets to Pwie.
- On Skill Use, gain Clash Power and Base Power if Pwie is the main target.
- At Combat Start, change all skill Coins to Unbreakable Coins.

passives.0.response.text: Initially targets Pwie and makes all skills Unbreakable. Intercept with Sinners to avoid the extra Power from keeping Pwie as the main target.

passives.1.effect.text:
Skills, Low Morale, and Panic inflict Tangling on enemies.
Tangling can be reduced by using Defense Skills or specific skills.

When hit:
- Gain 1 Bursting Blackstitch.
- If hit by a Slash skill, gain 1 additional Bursting Blackstitch.
- If hit by a skill with at least 5 Atk Weight, gain 1 Clumped Black Threads next turn (once per turn).

passives.1.condition.text: When hit, hit by Slash, or hit by at least 5 Atk Weight

passives.1.response.text: Attacks build Blackstitch and make the enemy easier to damage. Skills with at least 5 Atk Weight also build Clumped Black Threads, changing arm Clash Power and slot weight.

passives.2.effect.text:
When a part becomes Staggered, remove one Stagger Threshold from each other part and end the turn. All parts then gain Pool of Black Water next turn.

If a pool is removed by a hit:
- Gain 10 Bursting Blackstitch.
- If Blackstitch is gained beyond its maximum, gain 3 Fragile this turn and next turn.

If a pool expires at Turn End:
- Gain Bursting Blackstitch equal to (7 − remaining Potency).
- Gain 1 Instinct of the Predator of Eld next turn.

passives.2.response.text: Stagger ends the turn immediately; do not count on remaining attacks or healing. Reduce next turn's pools with multiple skills and prepare for predation after removal.

passives.3.effect.text:
HP damage, SP damage, and Stagger Threshold rise from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking −50%.

Panic type cannot change. If Panicked at Turn End, SP becomes 0.

passives.3.condition.text: Throughout combat; Panicked at Turn End

passives.3.response.text: Major status damage and Stagger Threshold rise are halved. Bring direct skill damage and check the all-Unbreakable Coins during Panic.
